name: fetch_filing_body
description: Fetch the full body of a SEC EDGAR filing by accession number. Returns the document as plain text (default) or HTML. Read-only.

accession.description: SEC accession number with dashes, e.g. "0000320193-25-000079". Get this from fetch_filings.

format.description: Body format. Defaults to text — strip HTML so the agent reads prose cleanly.
